name: Crônicas do Reino
storyline: Twenty years ago, a kingdom fell. Its people fled by sea, and on the way the royal crowns were melted down and forged into swords. The survivors settled on Ilha Brava and built Lume, a city with no king. Now the Tide has returned: grey portals open on the beaches, creatures that slept at the bottom of the sea wake up hungry, and the soldiers who drowned during the flight come back to fight against their own. Inside the walls, two great families, the Oliveira and the Soares, fight over the empty throne, while a secret cult hunts for forbidden knowledge in the catacombs beneath the city. Every player must choose which side to stand on.
summary: Crônicas do Reino is a fantasy MMORPG. Players arrive through a portal on Ilha Brava, the last refuge of a people who fled across the sea, and help defend the port city of Lume against the Tide, a dark force that raises sea creatures, fungal titans and even the drowned dead to retake the island. Explore an open world with a day and night cycle, take on story and faction quests, master your weapons, gather resources, delve into catacombs and gear up with armor sets assembled piece by piece, alongside other players.
